title: Cinderkeeper — The Last Egg
description: The obsidian guardian shelters its cracking egg beneath continuous crimson wings. A curved armoured neck, watchful amber eyes, sweeping ivory horns and a hooked golden-spined tail rise from a compact, lava-veined volcanic outcrop.

sections.name: Four gripping feet and rounded haunches
A continuous armoured chest and arched neck
A hooked tail with a curved armoured skin
Watchful amber eyes and sculpted open jaws
The warm rounded nest and cracking egg
